Exercise normal precaution

in **Malta**.

Malta is generally a safe destination for travelers.

  * Riptides have caused drowning deaths among tourists. U.S. citizens should use caution when at local beaches and follow lifeguards’ instructions.
  * Review our [Travel Guidance](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/malta.html#requirements "Travel Guidance") for Malta to learn how to prepare for a safe trip.
